name: Bagno a Ripoli (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bagno a Ripoli (a lion and keys on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI BAGNO A RIPOLI in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Bagno a Ripoli, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bagno a Ripoli arms — lion and keys on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI BAGNO A RIPOLI arched above the arms
